title: mold_v0 application spec
description: A complete description of one mold_v0 application, as one file. Check it with python3 .claude/scripts/factory.py spec check <file>; mint it with python3 .claude/scripts/mint.py new <app_id> --spec <file>. Generated by .claude/scripts/app_spec.py generate: never edit by hand.
markdownDescription:
A complete description of one **mold_v0** application (an MCP product: workspaces, keys, an MCP connector, an admin console, and the packs' records and runs).

- Check: `python3 .claude/scripts/factory.py spec check <file>`
- Mint: `python3 .claude/scripts/mint.py new <app_id> --spec <file>`

_Generated by `.claude/scripts/app_spec.py generate`; never edit by hand._

$schema.description: The schema this file follows (VS Code reads it for hovers and completion).
$schema.markdownDescription: The schema this file follows. Use `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/never2average/software-factory/main/schemas/mold_v0.app.schema.json`.

app_id.x-hint: 3 to 41 lower-case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter
app_id.description: The application's id: lower-case letters, digits and underscores (its folder under state/application/).
app_id.markdownDescription: The application's id, e.g. `acme_desk`: lower-case letters, digits and underscores. Its state lives in `state/application/<app_id>/`.

mold_id.description: The mold this app is made from: mold_v0.
mold_id.markdownDescription: The mold this app is made from. This schema is **mold_v0**'s.

kind.description: tool (default): people open the app itself. embedded: the app runs inside another product, which needs a developer surface and the platform audit trail.
kind.markdownDescription:
- `tool` (default): people open the app itself.
- `embedded`: the app runs **inside another product**; it then needs `developer_surface` and `audit.platform: true`.

product.title: The product people see
product.description: The brand: name, colour and logo are required (an app never ships under the mold's default name), tagline and domain optional.
product.markdownDescription: The brand people see. **name, colour and logo are required**: every new app is branded before its first deploy, never shipped under the mold's default name. `branding.py` derives the rest (palette, icon, sign-in mark) from these three.

name.x-hint: 1 to 60 characters, no full stop, < > or quotes
name.description: The product's name, as people see it (also its product id, lower-cased).
name.markdownDescription: The product's name, e.g. `Acme Desk`. A brief's `Product name:` line; names the product in `state/products.json` (created when new).

colour.markdownDescription: The brand colour, `#RRGGBB` (e.g. `#1F6F5C`). The palette, icon and legible foreground are derived from it.

logo.x-hint: a path in this repository like brands/acme/logo.svg
logo.description: The logo file, a path from the factory's root (usually brands/<name>/logo.svg or .png). It must be on this machine.
logo.markdownDescription: The logo file, a path from the factory's root: `brands/<name>/logo.svg` (or .png). `factory.py spec check` says when it is not on this machine.

domain.description: The app's own web address (optional; a server of its own needs one).
domain.markdownDescription: The app's own web address, e.g. `app.example.com`. Optional on Vercel; **required on a server of its own**.

deploy.title: Where it runs
deploy.description: Where the app runs: compose_remote, vercel (molds/mold_v0/mold.json targets).
deploy.markdownDescription:
Where the app runs (`molds/mold_v0/mold.json` `targets`):

- `vercel`: two Vercel projects, the API and the web console.
- `compose_remote`: a server of its own (Docker Compose behind its own Caddy); needs `product.domain`.

workspace.title: Who runs it
workspace.description: Who runs the app. mold_v0 needs at least one platform administrator; its companies are made in its own admin console.
workspace.markdownDescription:
Who runs the app. **`platform_admins` is required**: without one, everyone (the operator too) is told the app is invite-only.

`name`, `owner`, `members` are not supported on mold_v0: mold_v0 has organisations of its own, made in its admin console or by its org:create script, not workspaces written from state.

platform_admins.description: Who may open the admin console: addresses, or *@domain. A brief's Admins: line.
platform_admins.markdownDescription: Who may open the admin console: addresses, or *@domain. A brief's Admins: line.

budgets.title: Spending and rate limits
budgets.description: The app's limits over the shell's defaults (written to profile.limits): runs.budget_usd_max is the most one run may spend (US$), runs.kind_month_budget_usd the most one job kind may spend per company per month. Each is capped by the factory's ceiling.
budgets.markdownDescription:
The app's limits over the shell's defaults, written to `profile.limits` (a brief's `## Budgets`).

- `runs.budget_usd_max`: the most **one run** may spend, US$ (shell default 25).
- `runs.kind_month_budget_usd`: the most **one job kind per company per month**, US$ (default 200).

Each is capped by the factory's ceiling (`molds/mold_v0/branding/rules.json` `app_limits_max`). **Required when a pack has job kinds**, and must cover each kind's own `budget_usd` / `month_budget_usd`.

packs.title: The app's packs
packs.description: The app's packs: what makes it more than the mold (records, jobs, tabs, words), config only. [] for the mold as it comes.
packs.markdownDescription: The app's packs (config only, never a fork): ids, paths, or a pack.json inline. `[]`: the mold as it comes.

run_keys.title: Keys the runs need (names, never values)
run_keys.description: Where the keys the pack's job runs need will come from. Names only: the values go into the app's Key vault (its /admin Key vault page) or the server's environment, never here.
run_keys.markdownDescription:
Where the keys the packs' **job runs** need come from. **Never a value here**: the operator puts each key in the app's **Key vault** (`/admin` → Key vault), or in the server's environment.

- `model`: `anthropic` (an Anthropic API key) or `vertex` (a Vertex AI service-account key: Claude then runs on Vertex AI).
- `sandbox`: `boat` (boat.dev runs the sandboxes on Vercel).
- `object_storage`: where workspace snapshots go: `vault` (the Key vault's Object storage), `r2_env` (R2_* on the server) or `storage_dir` (APP_STORAGE_DIR, a server of its own).

Whether each is set: `provision.py <app> --operator vault-status --dry-run`.

model.description: anthropic: an Anthropic API key in the Key vault. vertex: a Vertex AI service-account key; Claude then runs on Vertex AI.
model.markdownDescription: anthropic: an Anthropic API key in the Key vault. vertex: a Vertex AI service-account key; Claude then runs on Vertex AI.

sandbox.description: boat: the boat.dev key for the runs' sandboxes (needed on Vercel when a pack has job kinds).
sandbox.markdownDescription: boat: the boat.dev key for the runs' sandboxes (needed on Vercel when a pack has job kinds).

object_storage.description: Where workspace snapshots of agent runs go: vault (the Key vault's Object storage), r2_env (R2_BUCKET, R2_ENDPOINT, R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID, R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY on the server), storage_dir (APP_STORAGE_DIR on a server of its own).

audit.title: Audit trails (mold_v0-197)
audit.description: Two audit trails, each on or off on its own (both default false). Separate from usage metering, which always stays on. Implemented by ticket mold_v0-197: until then the setting is recorded with the spec and has no effect.
audit.markdownDescription:
Two audit trails, **each on or off on its own** (both default `false`).

- `data`: every read, change, reveal and export of a workspace's records, visible to that workspace's admins.
- `platform`: every API and MCP request and every sign-in, with the key, the actor and the scope, plus staff actions on accounts.

Separate from **usage metering**, which always stays on. An `embedded` app needs `platform: true`.

_Implemented by mold_v0-197; until then it is recorded with the spec and has no effect._

data.title: Data audit trail
data.description: Every read, change, reveal and export of a workspace's records, visible to that workspace's admins.
data.markdownDescription: **Data audit trail**: every read, change, reveal and export of a workspace's records, shown to that workspace's admins. Default `false`.

platform.title: Platform audit trail
platform.description: Every API/MCP request and sign-in, with key, actor and scope, plus staff actions on accounts. Required (true) for kind embedded.
platform.markdownDescription: **Platform audit trail**: every API and MCP request and every sign-in, with the key, the actor and the scope, plus platform staff's actions on accounts. Default `false`; **must be `true` when `kind` is `embedded`**.

developer_surface.title: Developer surface (stub, mold_v0-193)
developer_surface.description: What a host application's developers build against when this app is embedded in it: the events it emits, the SDK languages it ships, and the client sessions the host's backend mints. A STUB: its shape is fixed now and mold_v0-193 implements it; until then it is recorded with the spec and has no effect. Required when kind is embedded.
developer_surface.markdownDescription:
What a **host application's developers** build against when this app is embedded in their product.

- `events`: what the embedded app tells the host about (name + meaning).
- `sdk_languages`: the SDKs it ships.
- `client_sessions`: short-lived sessions the host's own backend mints for its signed-in users.

**Stub**: the shape is fixed now, **mold_v0-193** implements it. Required when `kind` is `embedded`.

events.title: Events the embedded app emits
events.description: Each event the embedded app emits to its host page and to the host's webhook: a dotted lower-case name and what it means.
events.markdownDescription: Each event the embedded app emits (to the host page, and to the host's webhook): `name` like `record.created`, `description` in one sentence, and optionally `payload`, a JSON Schema of its data.

name.description: The event's name: dotted lower case, e.g. record.created, run.finished.
name.markdownDescription: The event's name: dotted lower case, e.g. record.created, run.finished.

description.description: What the event means, in one sentence.
description.markdownDescription: What the event means, in one sentence.

payload.description: Optional: a JSON Schema of the event's data (draft 2020-12).
payload.markdownDescription: Optional: a JSON Schema of the event's data (draft 2020-12).

sdk_languages.title: SDK languages
sdk_languages.description: The languages the app's client SDK ships in.
sdk_languages.markdownDescription: The languages the client SDK ships in, e.g. `["typescript", "python"]`.

client_sessions.title: Client sessions
client_sessions.description: Short-lived sessions the host application's backend mints for its own signed-in users, so they use the embedded app without a second sign-in.
client_sessions.markdownDescription: Short-lived sessions the **host's backend** mints for its own signed-in users (no second sign-in). `ttl_seconds`: how long one lasts; `allowed_origins`: the host pages (https) that may embed the app; `scopes`: what a session may do.

ttl_seconds.description: How long one session lasts, in seconds (60 to 86400).
ttl_seconds.markdownDescription: How long one session lasts, in seconds (60 to 86400).

allowed_origins.description: The host pages allowed to embed the app: https origins like https://app.example.com.
allowed_origins.markdownDescription: The host pages allowed to embed the app: https origins like https://app.example.com.

scopes.description: What a client session may do, e.g. read, write, run. Absent: read and write.
scopes.markdownDescription: What a client session may do, e.g. read, write, run. Absent: read and write.

pack.description: A mold_v0 pack (molds/mold_v0/MOLD.md, 'Pack and record-area contract'). Generated from src/pack-manifest.ts by npm run gen:pack-schema; do not edit.

requests.research_alternatives.description: the label of the products a request's research brief compares the company with (/admin/requests). The shell's own: Alternatives

pack_ref.title: One pack
pack_ref.description: A pack the app adds to the mold: its id (packs/<id>/ on this machine), {"id", "path"} to a pack.json file, or {"id", "pack"} with the pack.json inline.
pack_ref.markdownDescription:
A pack (the app's own records, jobs, tabs, words: config only, no fork). Three forms:

- `"acme"`: the pack already on this machine, `packs/acme/files/packs/acme/pack.json`.
- `{"id": "acme", "path": "specs/acme.pack.json"}`: a pack.json file.
- `{"id": "acme", "pack": { ... }}`: the pack.json **inline**, checked against the mold's own `packs/pack.schema.json` (embedded here).
